title: Fix How It Acts, Not How It Thinks: Surgical Fine-Tuning of Frontier LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.32064v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Open-weight LLMs are competent software engineers, but they sometimes fail at tasks they are otherwise able to do. Often it is not a failure of reasoning. It is a few small missteps over a long trajectory (repeating a step that has already failed, or declaring the task done while a requirement is still unmet) that make the difference. Correcting this calls for a surgical weight update that steers the model toward the right actions without interfering with its reasoning. Such updates, typically learned with LoRA adapters, are often too small to survive merging into a released checkpoint. In our BF16 release, the median weight change is only 1.5% of a single rounding step, and merging loses roughly two thirds of the update's norm. When the same adapter is merged into the mixed FP8/NVFP4 release of the same model, 93% of the update disappears. translated_title: 修正行动而非思维：前沿大语言模型的精细微调
translated_abstract: 开放权重大语言模型是胜任的软件工程师，但它们有时会在本可以完成的任务上失败。这通常并非推理能力的缺陷，而是长执行轨迹中的几个小失误造成的差异（例如重复已经失败的步骤，或在需求尚未满足时就宣告任务完成）。纠正这一点需要对权重进行精细的更新，引导模型采取正确的行动而不干扰其推理过程。这类更新通常通过 LoRA 适配器学习得到，但往往过于微小，以至于在合并到发布的 checkpoint 时无法保留。在我们的 BF16 版本中，权重变化的中位数仅为单个舍入步长的 1.5%，合并后会损失约三分之二的更新范数。当同一个适配器合并到同一模型的 FP8/NVFP4 混合精度版本时，93% 的更新会消失。我们没有增大更新的规模，而是直接在合并后残存的部分上进行训练。我们引入……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出一种“精细微调”方法，不增大更新规模，而是直接在权重更新合并后残存的部分上进行训练，从而在不干扰模型推理能力的前提下纠正其行动层面的小失误，并解决了 LoRA 小幅更新在合并到量化发布版本时大量丢失的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes a surgical fine-tuning approach that trains directly on the surviving portion of weight updates after merging (rather than enlarging the updates), correcting LLM behavioral missteps without interfering with reasoning, and addressing the problem of small LoRA updates vanishing when merged into quantized released checkpoints.
